name: Youth Art Exchange After-School Programs
what_you_do: You can join free after-school art programs for public high school students. Professional artists lead them, and they build creative, technical and leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Mainly public high school students in San Francisco. Programs are free.
notes: Also runs summer camps for grades 3 to 5 and classes for adults. The page does not mention paid internships or exact ages.
